verdict.rationale: Stripe Financial Connections is a bank-account linking and financial-data API (balances, ownership, transactions). It has no user-authored automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations falls outside this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an automation-authoring feature that would make the axis apply. Webhooks, the relink API, the MCP server and the CLI are integration primitives, not versioned automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
